title: Vascular perfusion of mice
author: Peter Mundel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8ezhtf6

steps.title: Prepare Perfusion Setup
steps.instruction: Set up the perfusion system and prepare the necessary solutions.

substeps.instruction: Fix small diameter tubes (below 1 cm) to two bottles: one for PFA and one for sucrose.
Fill bottles with freshly prepared and filtered (0.22 μm filter) perfusion solutions.
Adjust perfusion pressure to 150-160 mm Hg.
Fix a 23 gauge 3/4 butterfly needle at the end of the tubing after the valve.
Remove all air from the tubing.

steps.title: Prepare Perfusion Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the specific chemical solutions required for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Solution #1: 4% PFA in PBS, pH 7.4.
Prepare Solution #2: 18% Sucrose in PBS, pH 7.4.

steps.title: Anesthetize and Fix Animal
steps.instruction: Administer anesthesia and secure the mouse for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Prepare anesthetic mix by combining 3 ml ketamine (100mg/ml), 1 ml xylazine (20mg/ml), and 6 ml sterile saline.
Administer ketamine-xylazine mix at a dose of 150/10 mg/kg (0.1 ml per 20 g body weight).
Fix the anesthetized animal in a plastic tray.

steps.title: Expose Abdominal Vessels
steps.instruction: Surgically expose the abdominal aorta and vena cava.

substeps.instruction: Swab mouse fur with 70% alcohol to wet it.
Make a longitudinal incision in the abdominal skin.
Remove skin and gut to expose the abdominal aorta and vena cava.
Clean the abdominal aorta and vena cava of connective tissue and fat using cotton swabs.

steps.title: Cannulate and Initiate Perfusion
steps.instruction: Insert the needle and begin the perfusion process.

substeps.instruction: Clamp the abdominal aorta and vena cava in the area of the iliac arteries.
Insert the 23 gauge 3/4 butterfly needle into the aorta below the renal arteries.
Immediately cut open the vena cava with small, sharp scissors to allow rapid drainage of solutions.
Carefully monitor the needle throughout the entire perfusion process.

steps.title: Perform Perfusion Sequence
steps.instruction: Perfuse the animal with PFA followed by sucrose.

substeps.instruction: Perfuse with Solution #1 (PFA, pH 7.4) at 37ºC for 3 minutes.
Switch the valve to Solution #2 without interrupting pressure or flow.
Perfuse with Solution #2 (sucrose, pH 7.4) at 37ºC for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Harvest Organs and Clean Up
steps.instruction: Collect the target tissue and prepare the system for the next animal.

substeps.instruction: Stop perfusion and remove the butterfly needle.
Cut out kidneys at the renal hilum for further processing.
Rinse the tubing and needle extensively before starting the next animal.
